title: openwashdata package standards
text: standard two tiers. Required items publication floor block publication: raw data preserved data-raw/ processing script, PII sensitivity check done front, description data, dictionary description per variable, plus publication mechanics (CC 4.0 license, valid citation files, devtools::check() passes, data loads, .rda data/ CSV/XLSX exports inst/extdata/, website deployed pkgdown workflow). title: openwashdata package standards
text: PII sensitivity come first: data pushed anywhere public PII sensitivity check run column names sampled values every dataset. check covers every revision git history, current files: identifying data removed earlier commit stays recoverable clone, clean working tree enough. direct identifiers (person names, phone numbers, email addresses, national beneficiary IDs, household-level GPS coordinates) data file historical revision. Household- person-level data requires named human sign-review issue; agent never certifies . Identifying data found history blocks publication history cleaned. data-raw/dictionary.csv covers every variable every dataset, one-sentence plain-language description. description important field; written confirmed human, never invented agent. file keeps five washr columns (directory, file_name, variable_name, variable_type, description), UTF-8 without byte order mark, one class name per variable_type value; organization catalog parses way. Vignettes live vignettes/articles/, never directly vignettes/. keeps pkgdown rendering correct avoids CRAN issues. _pkgdown.yml follows standard configuration , including analytics header funding sidebar organization profile, brand wiring profile defines brand. remove reorganize blocks. website deployed pkgdown GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml) gh-pages branch every push main. docs/ ignored never committed; local pkgdown::build_site() preview . Analysis, validation, testing scripts live analysis/ package root. intentionally outside R/ built installed package. move delete ; exist reproducibility. license CC 4.0. change . Missing values coded NA, never empty strings, “NULL”, “N/”, sentinel numbers -99. Keywords coverage live DESCRIPTION, X-schema.org-keywords (comma separated), X-schema.org-spatialCoverage (place name), X-schema.org-temporalCoverage (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD). washr::update_citation() carries keywords CITATION.cff washr::update_metadata() reads three site metadata; type keywords CITATION.cff hand. editing DESCRIPTION, run washr::update_description(). version author changes, run washr::update_citation() DESCRIPTION, CITATION.cff, inst/CITATION stay sync. keeps DOI already file owns DOI badge README.Rmd; edit badge hand. washr 1.2.0 newer floor calls. Raw data stays data-raw/, processed .rda data data/, CSV/XLSX exports inst/extdata/.

title: openwashdata package standards
text: Multi-dataset packages: one .rda data/ one roxygen .R file per dataset, unique, descriptive name; dataset named package. _pkgdown.yml reference index lists every dataset.
code: package-name/ ├── DESCRIPTION ├── NAMESPACE ├── R/package-name.R          # roxygen data documentation ├── data/package-name.rda     # single dataset: named after the package ├── data-raw/ │   ├── data_processing.R │   └── dictionary.csv ├── inst/ │   ├── CITATION │   └── extdata/              # CSV and XLSX exports ├── man/ ├── vignettes/articles/       # all vignettes go here ├── analysis/                 # analysis scripts, not built ├── pkgdown/templates/in-header.html   # schema.org JSON-LD from washr::update_metadata(), Rbuildignored ├── _brand.yml                # only when the org profile defines a brand (washr::use_brand()) ├── logos/                    # the brand's logo files, same condition ├── README.Rmd / README.md ├── NEWS.md ├── CITATION.cff ├── _pkgdown.yml ├── .gitignore                # ignores docs/ (the site is built in CI) └── .github/workflows/     ├── R-CMD-check.yaml      # washr::setup_ci(); triggers include dev     └── pkgdown.yaml          # builds and deploys the site to gh-pages

title: Antibiotic Resistance of P. aeruginosa from the Buriganga River
text: figure resistance-shares shows, antibiotic, share 50 isolates tested susceptible, intermediate resistant. Resistance concentrated cefotaxime tetracycline, 88 percent isolates resistant, every isolate susceptible piperacillin-tazobactam.
code: library(burigangaamr) library(dplyr) library(ggplot2)  shares <- burigangaamr |>   count(antibiotic, interpretation) |>   group_by(antibiotic) |>   mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>   ungroup()  antibiotic_order <- shares |>   group_by(antibiotic) |>   summarise(resistant = sum(share[interpretation == "resistant"])) |>   arrange(resistant) |>   pull(antibiotic)  shares |>   mutate(antibiotic = factor(antibiotic, levels = antibiotic_order)) |>   ggplot(aes(x = share, y = antibiotic, fill = interpretation)) +   geom_col() +   scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c(susceptible = "#5B8E7D",                                intermediate = "#E1B12C",                                resistant = "#B5473B")) +   labs(x = "Share of the 50 isolates", y = NULL, fill = NULL,        title = "Disc diffusion results per antibiotic") +   theme_minimal()

title: Antibiotic Resistance of P. aeruginosa from the Buriganga River
text: data come supplementary material Sharif, D. ., Amin, F., Mehbub, M. H. Ratul, R. . (2024). Distribution antibiotic resistance patterns Pseudomonas aeruginosa across different point sources pollution Buriganga River, Bangladesh. Journal Water Health, 22(12). https://doi.org/10.2166/wh.2024.270. article supplement published Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. original authors listed package data contributors; reviewed package. changed material. eight Word tables supplement read R (script data-raw/data_processing.R). two isolate antibiotic matrices (zone diameters table S3, interpretations table S4) reshaped one observation per isolate antibiotic, antibiotic codes expanded names, classes disc contents tables S1 S2, breakpoints table S2 split numbers, counts per isolate derived observations. Tables S5, S7 S8 summaries republished; processing script reproduces every percentage S5 S8 data. Two statements supplement article agree , package keeps supplement : Table S6 flags 14 isolates multidrug resistant, table S7 abstract count 13. difference isolate B1c, resistant two antibiotic classes. abstract reports 4 percent isolates (two) resistant imipenem meropenem; table S4 one isolate . Table S6 lists ciprofloxacin (CIP) among nonsusceptible antibiotics isolate G3a, tables S3 S4 record 35 mm zone susceptible result ciprofloxacin resistant result cefotaxime (CTX) instead. counts per isolate come tables S3 S4; listed codes come table S6. Surface water sampled 1 March 15 May 2023, pre-monsoon season, seven points along river Sadar Ghat Midford Ghat, chosen nearby source pollution (article, Methods Table 2); 70 P. aeruginosa isolates obtained 50 tested nine antibiotics. site descriptions Table 2 dictionary site.
